title: AssertChecks case catalog
description: What must hold. Uploaded with every report. AssertChecks reads only the fields below; a project may add its own fields, which are kept and ignored. Case IDs are unique in the catalog and Then IDs are unique in their case.

id.description: Stable case ID, for example E2E-001. A Playwright test title starts with it: "E2E-001: ...".

status.description: active: required in the run and must pass. draft: listed, not run. retired: kept for its ID, not shown.

run.description: nightly: part of every full run. manual: runs only when named with --cases.

failure.description: Optional known, investigated failure note, shown next to the case.

id.description: Assertion ID, for example A1. A Playwright step title starts with it: "Then A1: ...".
